sources.title: 東京メトロ
sources.attribution: 東京メトロ 駅の路線 のりかえ情報 (facts only; not reproduced)
sources.notes: ライセンスなし・事実のみ参照（複製なし）。The shared transfer table behind the station page's のりかえ出口案内 tab. Read per line tab: 丸ノ内線, 有楽町線, 副都心線. Took only the 池袋 and 新宿 rows — the printed transfer line names and their 東京メトロ線 / 他社線 grouping. These rows print no gate, passage or exit.

sources.title: 池袋駅/M25/Y09/F09 | 路線・駅の情報 | 東京メトロ
sources.attribution: 東京メトロ 池袋駅ページ (facts only; not reproduced)
sources.notes: ライセンスなし・事実のみ参照（複製なし）。Read the のりかえ鉄道会社 row of the station table (JR東日本 / 東武鉄道 / 西武鉄道) as corroboration of the transfer table. The のりかえ出口案内 tab renders its transfer gates only inside direction diagrams (figure_platform_m25/y09/f09_a|b.png); no text names them, so nothing was taken from it. The 出口案内 table lists exits with nearby facilities only.

sources.title: 新宿駅/M08 | 路線・駅の情報 | 東京メトロ
sources.attribution: 東京メトロ 新宿駅ページ (facts only; not reproduced)
sources.notes: ライセンスなし・事実のみ参照（複製なし）。Read the のりかえ鉄道会社 row (都営地下鉄 / JR東日本 / 京王電鉄 / 小田急電鉄) and the 出口案内 table dated 2023年12月. The exit table's 近隣施設・建物 column prints JR新宿駅 gate names (南口・新南改札・甲州街道改札, ミライナタワー改札) beside exits A8 and A9, and 新宿駅（小田急線） beside A12; these read as nearby-place labels, not as transfer instructions, so they are recorded only as an observation in the note file. The commented-out block in the HTML belongs to another station's template and was ignored.

notFound: Tokyo Metro 池袋 and 新宿: the のりかえ出口案内 tab and the per-line 路線ごとののりかえ出口案内 page (line_marunouchi/line_yurakucho/line_fukutoshin position.html?station=ikebukuro) show the transfer gates, passages and exits only inside direction diagrams (figure_platform_m25/y09/f09_a|b.png). No text on either page names them, and diagram images were not read, so every viaLabels and viaPoiIds here is empty.
Seibu 池袋: 駅構内のご案内 is a map image. The only gate names printed in text (1F改札口, B1F改札口) come from the AED notice and are not tied to any transfer line.
Toei 新宿: the 乗り換え案内 block names lines only, and the 構内図 is an image. The 出入口一覧 prints gate names (マインズタワー方面改札, 京王新線口, 新都心口) but as part of exit entries, not of a transfer statement.

Walking times between the listed lines: none of the four station pages states one for these stations (the only 移動時間目安 block on the Tokyo Metro pages sits in a commented-out template belonging to another station and was ignored).
Platform positions and car numbers: they appear only in the Tokyo Metro diagrams and are deliberately not recorded.

東京メトロ丸ノ内線 at 新宿 (M08) does not appear in the Toei page's 乗り換え案内, and 都営新宿線 does not appear in the Tokyo Metro transfer row for 新宿; neither page states a transfer between those two, so none is recorded.
conflicts: Asymmetry, not a contradiction: the Tokyo Metro transfer row for 新宿 lists 都営大江戸線 (with the printed note [新宿駅・新宿西口駅]) but not 都営新宿線, while the Toei 乗り換え案内 at the same station lists JR山手線, 中央・総武線（各駅停車）, 中央線快速, 埼京線, 湘南新宿ライン, 京王線 and 小田急線 but no 東京メトロ line. Each page is silent about lines the other one names; both are recorded exactly as printed.

Naming difference: the Toei page's transfer list prints 京王線, while its own 出入口一覧 labels exits 3, 4 and 5 with the gate name 京王新線口. The two printed names differ and the page does not state in words that this gate serves the 京王線 transfer, so no via label was attached.

Line naming: the Seibu page prints 池袋線 for its own line and 東京メトロ有楽町線 / 東京メトロ副都心線 / 東京メトロ丸ノ内線 for the Metro lines, while the Tokyo Metro page prints 西武池袋線 for the Seibu line. Each entry keeps the wording of its own source.
